title: Make business memory a shared platform service
supabiz_proposal: Store evidence, records, decisions, procedures and preferences separately behind one scoped retrieval interface. Model swaps retain approved context.

title: Retrieve for the task before asking users to repeat history
supabiz_proposal: Offer a small relevant context package with citations, freshness and an explicit missing-memory fallback. Bound tokens and delay.
measure: Context relevance, p95 latency, human re-explanation

title: Keep live records authoritative
supabiz_proposal: Read current stock, notice, assignment or payment state from its authoritative source. Use memory for rationale and history, and surface conflicts.

title: Resolve tenant and source permissions before retrieval
supabiz_proposal: Derive business identity from authenticated context. Restrict candidates before content enters generation or external reranking; recheck selected evidence.

title: Make the answer audience part of authorization
supabiz_proposal: A private owner view and a staff-group reply use different allowed context. Evaluate the intended destination before composing the answer.

title: Carry lineage and restrictions into derived memory
supabiz_proposal: Require permission for all protected inputs by default. A broader redacted summary needs deliberate disclosure approval, not merely summarization.

title: Invalidate memory when access or facts change
supabiz_proposal: Track source and policy versions; evict stale caches and descendants. Reconstruct future agent context after revocation and explain prior transmissions cannot be recalled.
measure: Revocation delay; stale cache hits; invalidated descendants

title: Separate recording, recall and transmission
supabiz_proposal: Show Save new memory, Use saved memory and Cloud processing separately, with business/device/session scope. A failed setting change remains unconfirmed.

title: Capture payloads deliberately
supabiz_proposal: Inventory serialized prompts, tool output, metadata and media extracts. Redact or exclude before transmission where required; a truncated preview is insufficient.
measure: Sensitive fields leaving allowed scope; capture completeness

title: Show why this context was used
supabiz_proposal: Expose permitted citations, source time, evidence status and relevance. Let users exclude an item for this task without deleting institutional history.

title: Separate correcting, suppressing and deleting
supabiz_proposal: Use exact evidence references. Preserve audit history for correction; separately implement retention deletion and derived-index/cache handling.
measure: Repeat stale claims; unintended suppression; deletion coverage

title: Promote reviewed procedures from real work
supabiz_proposal: Suggest procedures with owner, version, scope and dependencies. High-impact operational changes require review and replay tests before promotion.

title: Keep retrieved evidence below executable policy
supabiz_proposal: Tag memory as evidence, not instructions. Retrieved claims cannot grant tools, share secrets or execute a suggested skill without normal authorization.

title: Use portable handoff packages with integrity checks
supabiz_proposal: Transfer approved summary, records, pending work, sources and explicit permissions. Validate target capability/context budget and preserve provenance.
measure: Handoff completeness; permission widening; lost task state

title: Give memory a visible owner and review date
supabiz_proposal: Show who approved each reusable rule, where it applies and when to review it. Separate personal habits from organization policy.

title: Evaluate with time-correct memory and permissions
supabiz_proposal: Replay dated cases with no future answers/corrections. Compare no memory, unstructured retrieval and scoped memory under equal quality and access constraints.
measure: Verified quality, leakage, total cost and time

title: Budget the entire memory lifecycle
supabiz_proposal: Count capture, extraction, embeddings, ranking, injected tokens, storage, invalidation and human review. Benchmark filters and update workloads.
measure: Cost per verified task; cold-start and steady-state latency

title: Connect shared memory to bounded collaboration
supabiz_proposal: Exchange purpose-scoped approved context through Relay. The receiving business keeps independent authority; shared memory never becomes a universal access grant.
